empty_forecast_check.rule: D-A40: an event whose stable-peer target set and forecast set are both empty is not scorable in the stable lane; it is excluded from the cell's scored events (every metric) and counted; every other event is scored by the unchanged pinned code

float32_scoring.use: label-free float64 decision check of the stable cells only; no consumer is patched with it

not_scorable.rule: D-A40: an event whose stable-peer target set and forecast set are both empty is not scorable in the stable lane; it is excluded from the cell's scored events (every metric) and counted; every other event is scored by the unchanged pinned code
not_scorable.scope: the stable consumer's persistence and its private m.score_cell only

parallel_scoring.scope: private copies on the stable consumer's m only; shared bgbench, primary evaluator and m.original.evaluate_new_period untouched; inert before the label
